description:
Join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD, as an SDC/Infection Control Nurse. This vital role combines staff development and infection prevention, ensuring the highest standards of care and employee competency. You will play a crucial part in maintaining a safe and healthy environment for both residents and staff.

In this dual-focused position, you will be responsible for developing and implementing educational programs for staff, fostering continuous professional growth. Concurrently, you will lead infection control initiatives, monitoring practices, and ensuring compliance with all regulatory guidelines to prevent the spread of infections.

We offer a competitive hourly rate of $40.00 - $42.00, reflecting your expertise and dedication. If you are a proactive and experienced nurse passionate about education and patient safety, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Minimum of 2 years of nursing experience, preferably in a long-term care setting
Experience in staff education or development
Knowledge of infection prevention and control principles
